title: Questions 158-160 refer to the following press release.
passage_1:
March 4

Larkfield Transit is prepared to take the next step to expand its fleet capacity. On March 26, the company will start constructing a new maintenance center in Dunmore. The groundbreaking ceremony will be attended by several company directors, as well as Mayor Alcott and other county council members. During the ceremony, Larkfield Transit president Ruth Okimoto intends to thank Mayor Alcott personally for his support, especially for revising the zoning rule that barred vehicle yards inside the town boundary.

Over the following three weeks, several streets in the Calder ward will be blocked at certain hours to allow gravel and machinery to be moved to the building site. Residents may experience short delays while traffic is briefly rerouted. Visit www.dunmore.gov/roads to view a map of expected blockages. We apologise for any trouble this may create and will do all we can to limit interruptions.
